title: SKE Crystal Plus Hawaiian Sunrise Prefilled Pods 20mg
description: Please Note: These pods are not compatible with the SKE BAR device. Hawaiian Sunrise flavour SKE Crystal Plus prefilled pods transport you to paradise with a vibrant blend of tropical fruits, including juicy pineapple, zesty citrus, and sweet, sun-ripened mango. The perfectly balanced medley of flavours creates a smooth and refreshing vape that’s ideal for all-day enjoyment. Made for use with the SKE Crystal Plus Pod Kit, these prefilled pods offer the same vibrant flavours and iconic crystalline design that made SKE Crystal Bars so popular. The prefilled and sealed design provides a hassle-free vaping experience, eliminating the need for refills or coil changes. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, which ensures a smoother throat hit and quicker nicotine absorption. Combined with the integrated 1.1ohm mesh coil, these pods deliver exceptional flavour and a satisfying mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw that’s perfect for nic salt and 50/50 e-liquids. Please Note: SKE Crystal Plus pods include a protective seal that must be removed before use. Detach the bung from the top of the mouthpiece and allow the pod to sit for 5-10 minutes to ensure the coil is fully saturated with e-liquid, preventing dry hits or burnt coils
